visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a person's hands holding a large red and yellow scratch card themed for the Lunar New Year. The person uses a small flat object to scratch the silver surface of the lottery ticket. The background shows a slightly blurred pavement. (2) The scene cuts to a young man in a black hoodie and mask standing inside a brightly lit lottery shop. He carefully selects a card from a wall-mounted display filled with rows of lottery tickets. (3) He takes the ticket to an outdoor table and continues scratching. The camera alternates between his focused facial expressions and close-up views of the card symbols as they are revealed. (4) The man returns inside and hands the card to an older shopkeeper. The shop is small and cluttered with red and gold traditional decorations and various lottery products. (5) The shopkeeper scans the ticket using a handheld device while the man waits expectantly. The lighting is warm and natural within the shop. (6) After the result is shown, the man displays a mix of humor and slight frustration to the camera. He picks up another ticket to scratch, continuing the cycle of anticipation and result.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright electronic BGM begins alongside a young male's high-arousal exclamation. He speaks rapidly with varying pitch, expressing excitement. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX marks a visual transition. The sound of a coin scratching paper (broadband rhythmic friction) is prominent. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) A distinct 'beep' digital UI SFX occurs as a scanner is used. The speaker's voice lowers slightly as he interacts with another male speaker whose voice is lower and more neutral in tone. (4) A comedic 'crow' SFX plays during a moment of disappointment, followed by the main speaker's sarcastic tone. (5) The BGM continues until the end, accompanied by more rapid speech and a final percussive 'impact' SFX as the video cuts.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Selection -> Action -> Reveal -> Reflection
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share the exciting yet nerve-wracking experience of playing high-priced scratch cards, common during the Lunar New Year. It uses high-energy editing and comedic commentary to engage the audience in the creator's quest for a big win.
